answer: A farm running 123 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. Because the velvet stake is held until the glacier settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the ivory audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 34% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
